notes: Controlled vocabulary for literary passages. Values are stored per passage in library/literature.json under metadata.features (observed) and metadata.interpretation.features (interpretation). The existing prose descriptions and technique notes stay as they are; these terms are what the taste engine counts. 'basis' is observed (visible in the text) or interpretation (a reader's judgment). Add terms freely; never rename a published one.

second.label: second-person narration
second.definition: Told to a "you" who is the protagonist.

tense.label: tense
tense.definition: The main tense of the narration.

past.label: past tense
past.definition: Events are narrated as having happened.

present.label: present tense
present.definition: Events are narrated as they happen.

mixed.label: mixed tense
mixed.definition: The narration moves between present and past.

narration.label: narrative stance
narration.definition: The narrator's position in time relative to the events.

immediate.label: immediate narration
immediate.definition: The telling stays inside the moment of the events.

retrospective.label: retrospective narration
retrospective.definition: An older narrator looks back on the events.

epistolary.label: epistolary narration
epistolary.definition: The passage is a letter, diary or document addressed to someone.

sentenceLength.label: sentence length
sentenceLength.definition: The typical length of the sentences.

long.label: long sentences
long.definition: Most sentences run long, with many clauses.

varied.label: varied sentence length
varied.definition: Short and long sentences alternate noticeably.

paratactic.label: parataxis
paratactic.definition: Clauses are set side by side, joined by "and", commas or semicolons, with little subordination.

hypotactic.label: hypotaxis
hypotactic.definition: Main clauses carry many subordinate clauses that qualify them.

cumulative.label: cumulative sentences
cumulative.definition: A main clause comes first and modifying phrases accumulate after it.

fragmented.label: fragmented syntax
fragmented.definition: Sentence fragments and broken syntax are used deliberately.

ornate.label: ornate diction
ornate.definition: Rich, rare or highly decorative vocabulary.

figuration.label: figurative density
figuration.definition: How much metaphor, simile and vivid imagery the passage uses.

sparse.label: sparse figuration
sparse.definition: Little or no metaphor; mostly literal statement.

rich.label: rich figuration
rich.definition: Dense metaphor, simile or sensory imagery throughout.

none.label: no dialogue
none.definition: No speech is quoted or reported.

focus.label: focus
focus.definition: What the passage mainly attends to.

reflection.label: reflection
reflection.definition: Essayistic thought about memory, ideas or the world.

description.label: description
description.definition: Places, objects or people described at rest.

pace.label: pace
pace.definition: How narrative time relates to reading time.

scene.label: scene
scene.definition: A single moment told at about the speed it happens, or slower.

summary.label: summary
summary.definition: A stretch of time or a habit compressed into a few sentences.

digressive.label: digression
digressive.definition: The narration wanders from its course into association.

device.label: devices
device.definition: Named techniques visible in the passage.

repetition.label: repetition
repetition.definition: Words or structures repeated for effect.

polysyndeton.label: polysyndeton
polysyndeton.definition: Many conjunctions ("and … and … and") in close succession.

in-medias-res.label: in medias res
in-medias-res.definition: The passage begins in the middle of the action.

withheld-identity.label: withheld identity
withheld-identity.definition: A central figure is not named or explained.

unexplained-terms.label: unexplained terminology
unexplained-terms.definition: Words particular to the story's world are used without explanation.

close-detail.label: close detail
close-detail.definition: A small, exact physical detail is singled out.

mirroring.label: mirroring
mirroring.definition: Actions or phrases echo one another across the passage.

self-correction.label: self-correction
self-correction.definition: The narrator qualifies or revises their own statements.

hedging.label: hedging
hedging.definition: Uncertainty is admitted ("as it seemed to me").

retrospective-frame.label: retrospective frame
retrospective-frame.definition: An explicit act of remembering frames the events ("I remember").

unmarked-speech.label: unmarked speech
unmarked-speech.definition: Speech blended into narration without quotation marks.

stream-of-consciousness.label: stream of consciousness
stream-of-consciousness.definition: Thought rendered as an unbroken flow.

free-indirect.label: free indirect discourse
free-indirect.definition: Third-person narration takes on a character's thoughts and idiom.

list.label: catalogue
list.definition: A list of things, names or places.

register.label: register
register.definition: A reader's overall judgment of the prose's manner. Subjective.

restrained.label: restrained prose
restrained.definition: Understated and economical; feeling held back.

lyrical.label: lyrical prose
lyrical.definition: Cadenced and musical; feeling carried by sound and rhythm.

experimental.label: experimental prose
experimental.definition: Conventional form is broken or rearranged.

tone.label: tone
tone.definition: A reader's sense of the passage's emotional colour. Subjective.
